title: 关于番外
content_zh:
写完了红中跟淼淼，按照顺序是诸葛渊，由于一共有四篇诸葛渊番外，所以我准备把这四篇整合到一起写一个小长篇，还请各位读者朋友敬请期待。
《道诡异仙》关于番外 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，
内容更新后，请重新刷新页面，即可获取最新更新！
content_en:
I have finished writing Hongzhong and Miaomiao, and in order, Zhuge Yuan. Since there are four Zhuge Yuan extras in total, I am going to integrate these four into one short novel. All readers, please stay tuned.
Extras about "The Strange Fairy" are being downloaded, please wait a moment.
After the content is updated, please refresh the page to get the latest updates!
